measurement.initial_run: Pinned attempt 1 primes changed Dockerfile inputs and is excluded. The earlier unpinned series remains separate.
measurement.warm_runs: Five consecutive post-priming attempts of the same revision/event/cache scope and resolved inputs. Record hits and misses without selecting only all-hit runs. Protocol corrected on 2026-11-06.
measurement.elapsed: Latest completed job timestamp minus current attempt run_started_at.
measurement.summed_jobs: Sum completed_at minus started_at for every non-skipped job in this attempt.
measurement.initial_queue: Earliest job started_at minus current attempt run_started_at; later scheduling waits remain visible in job timestamps.
measurement.main: Historical contextual samples remain in ADR; controlled main measurements require reviewed merge and must not replay older mutable production tags.
measurement.resources: Use emitted runner/image/container metadata. Do not infer measured CPU, memory or cache hit state from runner labels. Unreported values remain unavailable.
measurement.first_actionable_failure: Earliest failed step completion minus attempt run_started_at; job-level failure completion is retained separately.
measurement.cache_classification: Inspect each main BuildKit invocation separately. cached means an explicit CACHED marker without visible command output; command_output_observed records execution evidence. Missing markers alone can represent layer materialization.
